g.text: Dimensioned centreline model · dimensions in mm · undeformed geometry
All six bases clamped: ux = uy = θz = 0
Solid rectangles; b × h in mm
h in frame plane; b out of plane
No pass/fail or overall safety claim.
36 nodes · 30 column segments · 25 beams · rigid joints · 55 individual centreline-length dimensions
Linear elasticity, small displacements; axial and Euler–Bernoulli bending only. Red arrows are nodal loads, not to scale.
Omitted: shear deformation, self-weight, buckling, out-of-plane behaviour and connection flexibility. No applied nodal moments.
Geometry: five 3200 mm bays and five 2800 mm storeys; overall centreline envelope 16000 × 14000 mm.
Scope: stated 2D frame only — not complete product or building validation.
